title: A Fully Discrete Variational Approximation of Mather Measures and Sets
summary: We introduce a fully--discrete variational approximation of Mather measures and sets for Tonelli Lagrangians on the flat torus, together with a numerical procedure for approximating the entire Mather set. The scheme is based on a fully--discrete Lax--Oleinik operator with integer winding labels. We prove an $O(τ+h/τ)$ error estimate for the critical value, convergence of critical solutions, and a finite-dimensional characterization of fully--discrete Mather measures.
